scheme_name: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivrutti Vetan Yojana
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Maharashtra's state old-age pension scheme for elderly citizens who don't qualify for or need supplementary support beyond the central pension.
benefits: Monthly state pension for eligible elderly beneficiaries.
eligibility: Age 65 years or above (criteria may vary by category)
application_steps: Apply through the Tehsil office or Setu/Aaple Sarkar centre
